C-EVENT-ACCEPTANCE-377.Summary: Independent UI acceptance and portable, source-derived LLM task catalogue delivery for event templates.
C-EVENT-ACCEPTANCE-377.Problem: The suggestion screen exposes competing selections; focus is lost after rendering. Runtime plan prompts are missing from exported catalogues, the auxiliary LLM archive relies on personal paths, and operational schema/release documentation is stale.

Goals.Goal: One visible selection/apply path with preserved manual state and reliable keyboard focus.
Export the exact runtime prompts, versions and response schemas with truthful standalone diagnostics.
Build and verify a portable catalogue archive without external project paths, hidden copies or claims of bundled models.
Record independent visual acceptance, actual application archive inclusion and current schema/release facts.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority: user request and issue377. Exact main base 7a902df7066ce3de9f57ca69ed646673267f6be4.

Schema33, applied migrations, runtime data/evidence/ACL, application version, full OS bundle builders and production installer remain unchanged. Minimal task-module exports may expose existing contracts without changing execution.
The auxiliary catalogue package is data and a diagnostic client, not a model, server installation or system-configuration update. It writes only the explicit output destination.
Risk verification must distinguish this catalogue-only archive from full Debian/Astra installation risk; unknown or broader deployment changes retain the complete existing gate.
Archive completed C-EVENT-TEMPLATES-375 with terminal status only. No release publication or production deployment is requested.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Macro redesign, new inference model/provider, schema changes, model-quality certification, altering installed services or system packages.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Independent designer verdict resolves ET-UX-01/02 with actual desktop/mobile browser evidence: one visible apply action, preserved manual selection and meaningful focus after changes.
The deterministic catalogue includes all existing assistant tasks plus plan extraction and departmental selection, reuses their runtime schemas/prompts and detects drift.
Standalone diagnostics send the corresponding request shapes and reject invalid HTTP/JSON/schema/id/quote results; tests do not claim real-model quality.
A clean checkout can build the catalogue package using explicit output arguments, with integrity metadata, no personal paths or automatic external writes.
The real application archive contains the UI, APIs, LLM modules/catalogue and migrations through33 with matching manifest hashes and embedded smoke success.
Current documentation distinguishes schema33 source code, tagged versions, published release assets and independent audit evidence.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head focused Playwright, catalogue archive verification, real runtime archive inclusion, final GRACE scope and independent design acceptance; full OS gate remains for broader deployment diffs.
